debug.description: Turn on debug mode: generate HTML files without running a browser (see --debug).

cut_at.description: Do not show files/directories below this percent (0.01–30) of their parents (see --cut-at).

diff_dir.description: Directory to store/read du-logs for diffing (see --diff-dir).

max_depth.description: Do not show anything below this directory depth (see --max-depth).

max_lines.description: Only consider this many largest entries from du output (see --max-lines).

save_state.description: Force saving current state, overwriting previous --discard (see --save-state).

link_files.description: Insert file links in HTML for browser access (see --link-files).

discard.description: Do not save current state, allow re-diffing later (see --discard).

with_mounts.description: Call du without -x (i.e., include mounted filesystems) (see --with-mounts).

browser.description: Force use of this textbrowser (GT5_BROWSER env var; see ENVIRONMENT).

charset.description: Force HTML charset instead of deriving from $LANG (GT5_CHARSET env var).

debug_dir.description: Directory for gt5.debug* output when --debug is set (GT5_DEBUG_DIR env var).

command_args.description: Positional arguments (directories or files) passed to gt5 (e.g., paths to directories or pregenerated du logs).
